sloka: ततो गुह: संत्वरितं श्रुत्वा भरतशासनम् ।प्रतिप्रविश्य नगरं तं ज्ञातिजनमब्रवीत् ।। २.८९.८ ।।
transliteration: tato guha: saṁtvaritaṁ śrutvā bharataśāsanam ।pratipraviśya nagaraṁ taṁ jñātijanamabravīt ।। 2.89.8 ।।

translations.english: Then at Bharata's command Guha returned to his habitation quickly and said to his relations:
